name: alibi
description: Passive work-log capture and daily reconciliation - turns Claude Code sessions into a timesheet-ready log of tickets and internal projects

interface.longDescription: Alibi records which repo, branch and ticket you worked on and for how long, then reconciles a messy day of parallel sessions into a single timesheet-ready log entry per project. Fully local: no network, no credentials, nothing written into your repositories.
capabilities: Passive capture of active working time per repository and branch
Daily reconciliation of overlapping parallel sessions
Markdown work log, Obsidian daily notes supported
interface.defaultPrompt: Reconcile my work log for yesterday.
